sources.title: GitHub - ai-models-lab/minimax-h3: MiniMax-H3-Hub, ComfyUI Workflows ...
sources.snippet: Official Hub for MiniMax H3 (minimaxh3.run) — An all-in-one open-source resource platform for MiniMax H3 (Hailuo AI 3.0), the state-of-the-art native multi-modal 2K AI video generation model with synchronized 3D stereo audio.

sources.title: H3-World: Keyboard-Controlled Interactive World Model on MiniMax H3
sources.snippet: H3-World turns MiniMax H3 into an interactive world model: a 65.6M LoRA plus an attention patch maps WASD and camera keys to action-controlled video from a single frame.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 on Comfy: Open-Weight Video Model
sources.snippet: Run MiniMax H3 on Comfy: Open Weights or Partner Nodes, multi-modal in/out, native stereo audio on every clip, up to 2K and 5-15s per generation. Free to start.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 Open: Tutorials, Deployment & Workflows
sources.snippet: Explore MiniMax H3 tutorials, deployment guides, creator workflows, and community videos.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 ComfyUI Workflows, Setup & Tutorial | MiniMax Design
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI Build Custom Multimodal AI Video Workflows Use MiniMax H3 and ComfyUI to connect prompts, models, parameters, images, video, audio, and outputs in reusable node-based workflows. Create text-to-video, image-to-video, first-and-last-frame, and reference-driven video with synchronized visuals, motion, and sound.
